'''Tatooine Planetary Insurance Company''' was an insurance company on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. It was known to insure both [[Airspeeder/Legends|airspeeder]] and [[Landspeeder/Legends|landspeeder]] rentals.
